obfuscation_indicators: many factors outside of our control
risk_summary: The disclosure provides meaningful quantitative operating and cash-flow information, but emphasizes substantial exposure to commodity-price volatility, reserve-estimation uncertainty, derivative mark-to-market swings, and asset-retirement obligations. Management uses generally cautious, partly boilerplate language around factors beyond its control and assumptions underlying reserves and liabilities, while maintaining a moderately positive outlook based on portfolio diversification and reserve growth.
